topic: Debugging mops build errors and dependencies
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on resolving a recurring compilation error when building 'mops' (a system component). The initial error was an `NGCC failed` exception, suggesting version incompatibility issues with Angular and Node.js dependencies.

Several versions of tools were tested, including different Node.js versions (v12.x, v14.x) and various Angular CLI/Angular package versions (e.g., 10.2.0, 11.2.3). The core issue was determined to be related to the specific versions of development tools required for compilation.

Ultimately, the error was resolved when reverting a file change detected by `git status` while changing tool versions, allowing the build process to complete successfully.
decisions: The Angular project dependencies were adjusted and downgraded/upgraded to resolve the build failure.
